title: Willow Glen：成熟街区与房屋个性
title_en: Willow Glen: established streets and homes with character
intro: Willow Glen 的特色在于成熟住宅街区、不同年代的建筑风格，以及 Lincoln Avenue 周边的商业生活设施。
intro_en: Willow Glen is known for established residential streets, homes from many eras, and the shops and restaurants around Lincoln Avenue.
buyer: 同在 Willow Glen，不同房屋可能在建筑年代、地块形状、停车条件、装修品质和步行便利性上差异明显。老房还应关注地基、排水、白蚁、许可记录和保险成本。
buyer_en: Within Willow Glen, homes can differ widely in age, lot shape, parking, quality of work and walkability. With older homes, also look at the foundation, drainage, termites, permit history and insurance cost.
seller: Willow Glen 的房屋不适合只用统一每平方英尺价格比较。历史风格、房屋维护、户外空间及临近主干道等因素，都需要在定价分析中体现。
seller_en: A single price per square foot does not work well here. Historic character, upkeep, outdoor space and proximity to busy streets all need to show up in the pricing analysis.
